creator_questions.content: What is the time complexity of quicksort in the average case and how does it compare to merge sort? Explain the pivot selection strategies and their impact on performance.
What are the differences between relational and NoSQL databases? When would you choose one over the other? Discuss ACID properties, scalability, and use cases for each type.
What is a RESTful API and how does it differ from SOAP? Explain the key principles of REST, HTTP methods, status codes, and best practices for API design.
What is a hash table and how does it handle collisions? Compare different collision resolution techniques including chaining, open addressing, and their trade-offs.
Describe how garbage collection works in Java. What are the different types of garbage collectors? Explain generational garbage collection and memory management strategies.
Explain the difference between a process and a thread. What are the advantages of using threads? Discuss context switching, memory sharing, and synchronization mechanisms.
What is deadlock and how can it be prevented? Explain the four necessary conditions for deadlock and discuss prevention, avoidance, and detection strategies.
How does HTTPS work under the hood? Explain the SSL/TLS handshake process, certificate validation, and encryption algorithms used for secure communication.
What is the difference between TCP and UDP? When would you use each protocol? Discuss reliability, ordering, congestion control, and real-world applications.
Describe the OSI model and the purpose of each layer. How does data flow through the layers? Explain encapsulation, protocols, and network devices at each level.
What is normalization in databases and why is it important? Explain the different normal forms, functional dependencies, and when to denormalize for performance.
Explain the difference between supervised and unsupervised learning. Provide examples of each, discuss algorithms, and real-world applications in machine learning.
What are the SOLID principles in software engineering? Explain each principle with examples, discuss their benefits, and how they improve code maintainability.
Explain the CAP theorem in distributed systems. How does it affect database design? Discuss consistency, availability, partition tolerance, and their trade-offs.
What is a binary search tree and how does it maintain its properties? Explain insertion, deletion, traversal algorithms, and balanced tree variants like AVL and Red-Black trees.
How does a load balancer work? Explain different load balancing algorithms, health checks, session persistence, and high availability configurations.
What is dependency injection and why is it useful? Explain different types of DI, inversion of control, and how it improves testability and modularity.
Explain the concept of virtual memory. How does it work with physical memory? Discuss paging, page replacement algorithms, and memory management strategies.
What is the difference between symmetric and asymmetric encryption? When would you use each? Discuss key exchange, digital signatures, and hybrid encryption systems.
How does a CDN work? Explain the benefits and challenges of using a CDN, edge caching strategies, and global content distribution networks.
What is the difference between a stack and a queue? When would you use each data structure? Discuss LIFO vs FIFO, implementations, and real-world applications.
Explain the concept of microservices architecture. What are the pros and cons? Discuss service boundaries, communication patterns, and deployment strategies.
What is a race condition? How can you prevent race conditions in concurrent programming? Discuss synchronization primitives, locks, and thread-safe programming.
How does a database index work? Explain different types of indexes and their use cases, B-tree structures, and query optimization strategies.
What is the difference between a linked list and an array? When would you choose one over the other? Discuss memory allocation, access patterns, and performance characteristics.
Explain the concept of caching. What are different caching strategies and when to use them? Discuss cache invalidation, consistency, and distributed caching systems.
What is the time complexity of binary search? How does it compare to linear search? Discuss divide-and-conquer algorithms and their applications.
How does a message queue work? Explain the benefits of using message queues in distributed systems, reliability patterns, and asynchronous processing.
What is the difference between a compiler and an interpreter? How do they process code differently? Discuss compilation phases, optimization, and runtime environments.
How does a reverse proxy work? What are the benefits of using a reverse proxy? Discuss load balancing, SSL termination, and security features.
What is the difference between a heap and a stack? How is memory allocated in each? Discuss memory management, garbage collection, and memory safety.
Explain the concept of database transactions. What are ACID properties? Discuss isolation levels, concurrency control, and transaction management.
What is the difference between a synchronous and asynchronous function? When would you use each? Discuss callbacks, promises, and async/await patterns.
How does a hash function work? What makes a good hash function? Discuss collision resistance, avalanche effect, and cryptographic hash functions.
What is the difference between a breadth-first search and depth-first search? When would you use each? Discuss graph traversal algorithms and their applications.
Explain the concept of database sharding. What are the benefits and challenges? Discuss horizontal partitioning, shard key selection, and distributed query processing.
What is the difference between a stateless and stateful service? When would you use each? Discuss session management, scalability, and distributed system design.
How does a distributed cache work? What are the challenges of implementing distributed caching? Discuss consistency models, cache coherence, and fault tolerance.
What is the difference between a monolith and microservices architecture? When would you choose each? Discuss service boundaries, deployment strategies, and operational complexity.
Explain the concept of database replication. What are the different replication strategies? Discuss master-slave, peer-to-peer, and eventual consistency models.
What is the difference between a process and a thread? How do they share resources? Discuss memory isolation, context switching, and multi-threading models.
How does a load balancer distribute traffic? Explain different load balancing algorithms, health checks, and high availability configurations for web applications.
What is the difference between a stack and a queue? When would you use each data structure? Discuss LIFO vs FIFO operations, implementations, and real-world use cases.
Explain the concept of database indexing. What are the different types of indexes? Discuss B-tree, hash indexes, composite indexes, and query optimization.
What is the difference between a binary tree and a binary search tree? How do they differ in structure? Discuss tree properties, traversal algorithms, and balanced trees.
How does a message broker work? What are the benefits of using message brokers? Discuss publish-subscribe patterns, message routing, and reliability guarantees.
What is the difference between a synchronous and asynchronous API? When would you use each? Discuss REST vs GraphQL, polling vs webhooks, and API design patterns.
Explain the concept of database partitioning. What are the different partitioning strategies? Discuss horizontal vs vertical partitioning and their trade-offs.
What is the difference between a heap and a stack? How is memory managed in each? Discuss dynamic memory allocation, garbage collection, and memory safety.
How does a distributed system handle failures? What are the different failure scenarios? Discuss fault tolerance, redundancy, and recovery mechanisms.
